groundTruth: Preliminary visual review + Commons titles/captions; not independently expert verified.
limitations: Small uneven sample: some classes only one test photo.
Groups link photographers and suspected same individuals/scenes; full cross-source identity checks remain incomplete.
Overlap with upstream ImageNet/CLIP pretraining data was not audited.
Internet images do not establish Kyoto zoo field accuracy.
Weight-only compression was added after initial test reports were inspected; it has validation results only and needs a fresh independent test set.
Current CLIP returns no species for rejected images, so its candidate metric counts those as unsuccessful; it is not raw CLIP argmax accuracy.
